# Problem 1
class Solver:
    def __init__(self, n, cats, vals):
        self.n = n
        self.cats = cats
        self.vals = vals
        self.var = {}
        self.domains = []
        for c in cats:
            for v in vals[c]:
                self.var[(c, v)] = len(self.domains)
                self.domains.append(list(range(n)))
        self.constraints = []
        for c in cats:
            vs = vals[c]
            for i in range(len(vs)):
                for j in range(i + 1, len(vs)):
                    self.add_bin(c, vs[i], c, vs[j], lambda x, y: x != y)

    def add_unary(self, c, v, keep=None, forbid=None):
        i = self.var[(c, v)]
        d = self.domains[i]
        if keep is not None:
            d = [x for x in d if x == keep]
        if forbid is not None:
            d = [x for x in d if x != forbid]
        self.domains[i] = d

    def add_bin(self, c1, v1, c2, v2, rel):
        i = self.var[(c1, v1)]
        j = self.var[(c2, v2)]
        if i == j:
            self.domains[i] = [x for x in self.domains[i] if rel(x, x)]
        else:
            self.constraints.append((i, j, rel))

    def eq(self, c1, v1, c2, v2):
        self.add_bin(c1, v1, c2, v2, lambda x, y: x == y)

    def direct_left(self, c1, v1, c2, v2):
        self.add_bin(c1, v1, c2, v2, lambda x, y: y == x + 1)

    def direct_right(self, c1, v1, c2, v2):
        self.add_bin(c1, v1, c2, v2, lambda x, y: y == x - 1)

    def left_of(self, c1, v1, c2, v2):
        self.add_bin(c1, v1, c2, v2, lambda x, y: y > x)

    def right_of(self, c1, v1, c2, v2):
        self.add_bin(c1, v1, c2, v2, lambda x, y: x > y)

    def next_to(self, c1, v1, c2, v2):
        self.add_bin(c1, v1, c2, v2, lambda x, y: abs(x - y) == 1)

    def between(self, c1, v1, c2, v2, gap):
        d = gap + 1
        self.add_bin(c1, v1, c2, v2, lambda x, y, d=d: abs(x - y) == d)

    def ac3(self, dom):
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for i, j, rel in self.constraints:
                if i == j:
                    continue
                di = dom[i]
                dj = dom[j]
                if not di or not dj:
                    return False
                new = []
                for x in di:
                    for y in dj:
                        if rel(x, y):
                            new.append(x)
                            break
                if len(new) != len(di):
                    dom[i] = new
                    di = new
                    changed = True
                    if not di:
                        return False
                new = []
                for y in dj:
                    for x in di:
                        if rel(x, y):
                            new.append(y)
                            break
                if len(new) != len(dj):
                    dom[j] = new
                    dj = new
                    changed = True
                    if not dj:
                        return False
        return True

    def search(self, dom):
        if not self.ac3(dom):
            return None
        best = -1
        best_len = 10**9
        for i, d in enumerate(dom):
            if len(d) > 1 and len(d) < best_len:
                best_len = len(d)
                best = i
        if best == -1:
            return [d[0] for d in dom]
        for val in dom[best]:
            new = [d[:] for d in dom]
            new[best] = [val]
            sol = self.search(new)
            if sol is not None:
                return sol
        return None

    def solve(self):
        sol = self.search(self.domains)
        if sol is None:
            print("No solution")
            return
        pos = {}
        for (c, v), idx in self.var.items():
            pos[(c, v)] = sol[idx]
        out = []
        for h in range(self.n):
            attrs = []
            for c in self.cats:
                for v in self.vals[c]:
                    if pos[(c, v)] == h:
                        attrs.append(v)
                        break
            out.append(f"House {h + 1}: " + ", ".join(attrs))
        print("\n".join(out))

# Problem 1
from itertools import combinations

def solve():
    n = 5
    categories = [
        ("name", ["Arnold", "Peter", "Bob", "Eric", "Alice"]),
        ...
    ]
    var = {}
    domains = []
    for ci, (cat, vals) in enumerate(categories):
        for val in vals:
            var[(cat, val)] = len(domains)
            domains.append(set(range(n)))
    arcs = {}
    def add_arc(a, b, pred):
        arcs.setdefault((a, b), []).append(pred)
    def add_binary(i, j, pred):
        add_arc(i, j, pred)
        add_arc(j, i, lambda x, y, p=pred: p(y, x))
    def all_diff(vals_vars):
        for a, b in combinations(vals_vars, 2):
            add_binary(a, b, lambda x, y: x != y)
    for cat, vals in categories:
        all_diff([var[(cat, v)] for v in vals])
    def eq(a, b): add_binary(var[a], var[b], lambda x, y: x == y)
    def direct_left(a, b): add_binary(var[a], var[b], lambda x, y: x + 1 == y)
    def left(a, b): add_binary(var[a], var[b], lambda x, y: x < y)
    def abs_diff(a, b, k): add_binary(var[a], var[b], lambda x, y: abs(x - y) == k)
    def next_to(a, b): add_binary(var[a], var[b], lambda x, y: abs(x - y) == 1)
    def fix(cat, val, pos): domains[var[(cat,val)]] = {pos}
    def notpos(cat, val, pos): domains[var[(cat,val)]].discard(pos)
    # apply clues...
    def ac3(dom):
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for (a, b), preds in list(arcs.items()):
                if not dom[a] or not dom[b]:
                    return False
                new_a = set()
                for x in dom[a]:
                    # if any y in dom[b] satisfies all preds
                    # use any with all
                    if any(all(p(x, y) for p in preds) for y in dom[b]):
                        new_a.add(x)
                if len(new_a) < len(dom[a]):
                    dom[a] = new_a
                    changed = True
                    if not dom[a]:
                        return False
        return True
    def search(dom):
        if not ac3(dom):
            return None
        unassigned = [i for i, d in enumerate(dom) if len(d) > 1]
        if not unassigned:
            return {i: next(iter(d)) for i, d in enumerate(dom)}
        # choose min domain, maybe max degree
        degree = {i: 0 for i in range(len(dom))}
        for (a,b) in arcs:
            degree[a] += 1
            degree[b] += 1
        v = min(unassigned, key=lambda i: (len(dom[i]), -degree[i]))
        for val in sorted(dom[v]):
            ndom = [set(d) for d in dom]
            ndom[v] = {val}
            sol = search(ndom)
            if sol is not None:
                return sol
        return None
    sol = search(domains)
    # print
    for h in range(n):
        attrs = []
        for cat, vals in categories:
            for val in vals:
                if sol[var[(cat, val)]] == h:
                    attrs.append(val)
        print("House {}: {}".format(h+1, ", ".join(attrs)))
solve()

# Problem 1
from itertools import combinations

def solve():
    n = 5
    categories = [
        ("name", ["Arnold", "Peter", "Bob", "Eric", "Alice"]),
        ("hair", ["gray", "brown", "black", "red", "blonde"]),
        ("vacation", ["city", "mountain", "camping", "cruise", "beach"]),
        ("flower", ["roses", "tulips", "carnations", "lilies", "daffodils"]),
        ("lunch", ["stew", "stir fry", "spaghetti", "pizza", "grilled cheese"]),
        ("hobby", ["painting", "photography", "gardening", "knitting", "cooking"]),
    ]
    var = {}
    domains = []
    for cat, vals in categories:
        for val in vals:
            var[(cat, val)] = len(domains)
            domains.append(set(range(n)))
    arcs = {}
    def add_arc(a, b, pred):
        arcs.setdefault((a, b), []).append(pred)
    def add_binary(i, j, pred):
        add_arc(i, j, pred)
        add_arc(j, i, lambda x, y, p=pred: p(y, x))
    for cat, vals in categories:
        vs = [var[(cat, v)] for v in vals]
        for a, b in combinations(vs, 2):
            add_binary(a, b, lambda x, y: x != y)
    def eq(a, b):
        add_binary(var[a], var[b], lambda x, y: x == y)
    def direct_left(a, b):
        add_binary(var[a], var[b], lambda x, y: x + 1 == y)
    def left(a, b):
        add_binary(var[a], var[b], lambda x, y: x < y)
    def abs_diff(a, b, k):
        add_binary(var[a], var[b], lambda x, y, k=k: abs(x - y) == k)
    def next_to(a, b):
        add_binary(var[a], var[b], lambda x, y: abs(x - y) == 1)
    def fix(cat, val, pos):
        domains[var[(cat, val)]] = {pos}
    def notpos(cat, val, pos):
        domains[var[(cat, val)]].discard(pos)

    direct_left(("lunch", "stew"), ("flower", "tulips"))
    eq(("vacation", "camping"), ("lunch", "grilled cheese"))
    left(("hair", "black"), ("name", "Bob"))
    eq(("hobby", "photography"), ("hair", "gray"))
    eq(("lunch", "pizza"), ("vacation", "cruise"))
    eq(("name", "Alice"), ("vacation", "city"))
    direct_left(("vacation", "beach"), ("hobby", "painting"))
    eq(("name", "Arnold"), ("lunch", "spaghetti"))
    fix(("name", "Bob"), 4)
    fix(("flower", "lilies"), 2)
    fix(("hobby", "knitting"), 3)
    direct_left(("hair", "brown"), ("hobby", "painting"))
    abs_diff(("vacation", "cruise"), ("hobby", "knitting"), 3)
    eq(("hair", "red"), ("lunch", "spaghetti"))
    notpos(("flower", "carnations"), 1)
    left(("name", "Eric"), ("hobby", "gardening"))
    eq(("hobby", "photography"), ("lunch", "stew"))
    eq(("name", "Eric"), ("flower", "daffodils"))

    degree = [0] * len(domains)
    for a, b in arcs:
        degree[a] += 1
        degree[b] += 1

    def propagate(dom):
        while True:
            changed = False
            for (a, b), preds in list(arcs.items()):
                if not dom[a] or not dom[b]:
                    return False
                new_a = set()
                for x in dom[a]:
                    if any(all(p(x, y) for p in preds) for y in dom[b]):
                        new_a.add(x)
                if len(new_a) < len(dom[a]):
                    dom[a] = new_a
                    changed = True
                    if not dom[a]:
                        return False
            for cat, vals in categories:
                vs = [var[(cat, v)] for v in vals]
                for p in range(n):
                    possible = [u for u in vs if p in dom[u]]
                    if not possible:
                        return False
                    if len(possible) == 1:
                        u = possible[0]
                        if dom[u] != {p}:
                            dom[u] = {p}
                            changed = True
                for u in vs:
                    if len(dom[u]) == 1:
                        p = next(iter(dom[u]))
                        for w in vs:
                            if w != u and p in dom[w]:
                                dom[w].remove(p)
                                changed = True
                                if not dom[w]:
                                    return False
            if not changed:
                return True

    def search(dom):
        if not propagate(dom):
            return None
        unassigned = [i for i, d in enumerate(dom) if len(d) > 1]
        if not unassigned:
            return {i: next(iter(d)) for i, d in enumerate(dom)}
        v = min(unassigned, key=lambda i: (len(dom[i]), -degree[i]))
        for val in sorted(dom[v]):
            ndom = [set(d) for d in dom]
            ndom[v] = {val}
            sol = search(ndom)
            if sol is not None:
                return sol
        return None

    sol = search(domains)
    if sol is None:
        raise SystemExit
    for h in range(n):
        attrs = []
        for cat, vals in categories:
            for val in vals:
                if sol[var[(cat, val)]] == h:
                    attrs.append(val)
        print("House {}: {}".format(h + 1, ", ".join(attrs)))

solve()

                                dom[w].remove(p)
                                changed = True
                                if not dom[w]:
                                    return False

            if not changed:
                return True

    def search(dom):
        if not propagate(dom):
            return None

        unassigned = [i for i, d in enumerate(dom) if len(d) > 1]
        if not unassigned:
            return {i: next(iter(d)) for i, d in enumerate(dom)}

        v = min(unassigned, key=lambda i: (len(dom[i]), -degree[i]))
        for val in sorted(dom[v]):
            ndom = [set(d) for d in dom]
            ndom[v] = {val}
            sol = search(ndom)
            if sol is not None:
                return sol
        return None

    sol = search(domains)
    if sol is None:
        raise SystemExit

    for h in range(n):
        attrs = []
        for cat, vals in categories:
            for val in vals:
                if sol[var[(cat, val)]] == h:
                    attrs.append(val)
        print("House {}: {}".format(h + 1, ", ".join(attrs)))

solve()

# Problem 1
def solve(n, categories, constraints):
    vars = []
    for cat, vals in categories:
        for val in vals:
            vars.append((cat, val))
    var_index = {v:i for i,v in enumerate(vars)}
    groups = {}
    for cat, vals in categories:
        groups[cat] = [(cat, val) for val in vals]
    domains = {v: set(range(1, n+1)) for v in vars}

    def reduce(dom, var, new):
        # new set
        if not new:
            return False
        if new != dom[var]:
            dom[var] = new
            return True
        return True

    def propagate(dom):
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for c in constraints:
                kind = c[0]
                if kind == 'house':
                    var, h = c[1], c[2]
                    if h not in dom[var]:
                        return None
                    if len(dom[var]) != 1:
                        dom[var] = {h}
                        changed = True
                elif kind == 'not_house':
                    var, h = c[1], c[2]
                    if h in dom[var]:
                        dom[var] = dom[var] - {h}
                        if not dom[var]:
                            return None
                        changed = True
                elif kind == 'same':
                    v1, v2 = c[1], c[2]
                    d1, d2 = dom[v1], dom[v2]
                    nd = d1 & d2
                    if not nd:
                        return None
                    if nd != d1:
                        dom[v1] = nd
                        changed = True
                    if nd != d2:
                        dom[v2] = nd
                        changed = True
                elif kind == 'left':
                    v1, v2 = c[1], c[2]
                    d1, d2 = dom[v1], dom[v2]
                    nd1 = {x for x in d1 if any(x < y for y in d2)}
                    nd2 = {y for y in d2 if any(x < y for x in d1)}
                    if not nd1 or not nd2: return None
                    if nd1 != d1: dom[v1]=nd1; changed=True
                    if nd2 != d2: dom[v2]=nd2; changed=True
                elif kind == 'right':
                    v1, v2 = c[1], c[2]
                    d1, d2 = dom[v1], dom[v2]
                    nd1 = {x for x in d1 if any(x > y for y in d2)}
                    nd2 = {y for y in d2 if any(x > y for x in d1)}
                    if not nd1 or not nd2: return None
                    if nd1 != d1: dom[v1]=nd1; changed=True
                    if nd2 != d2: dom[v2]=nd2; changed=True
                elif kind == 'directly_left':
                    v1, v2 = c[1], c[2]
                    d1, d2 = dom[v1], dom[v2]
                    nd1 = {x for x in d1 if (x + 1) in d2}
                    nd2 = {y for y in d2 if (y - 1) in d1}
                    if not nd1 or not nd2: return None
                    if nd1 != d1: dom[v1]=nd1; changed=True
                    if nd2 != d2: dom[v2]=nd2; changed=True
                elif kind == 'next_to':
                    v1, v2 = c[1], c[2]
                    d1, d2 = dom[v1], dom[v2]
                    nd1 = {x for x in d1 if any(abs(x - y) == 1 for y in d2)}
                    nd2 = {y for y in d2 if any(abs(x - y) == 1 for x in d1)}
                    if not nd1 or not nd2: return None
                    if nd1 != d1: dom[v1]=nd1; changed=True
                    if nd2 != d2: dom[v2]=nd2; changed=True
                elif kind == 'two_between':
                    v1, v2 = c[1], c[2]
                    d1, d2 = dom[v1], dom[v2]
                    nd1 = {x for x in d1 if any(abs(x - y) == 3 for y in d2)}
                    nd2 = {y for y in d2 if any(abs(x - y) == 3 for x in d1)}
                    if not nd1 or not nd2: return None
                    if nd1 != d1: dom[v1]=nd1; changed=True
                    if nd2 != d2: dom[v2]=nd2; changed=True
            # all-diff groups
            for cat, group in groups.items():
                # remove singleton values from others
                for var in group:
                    if len(dom[var]) == 1:
                        h = next(iter(dom[var]))
                        for other in group:
                            if other != var and h in dom[other]:
                                dom[other] = dom[other] - {h}
                                if not dom[other]:
                                    return None
                                changed = True
                # check duplicate singletons
                seen = set()
                for var in group:
                    if len(dom[var]) == 1:
                        h = next(iter(dom[var]))
                        if h in seen:
                            return None
                        seen.add(h)
        return dom

    def search(dom):
        dom = propagate(dom)
        if dom is None:
            return None
        unassigned = [v for v in vars if len(dom[v]) > 1]
        if not unassigned:
            return {v: next(iter(dom[v])) for v in vars}
        var = min(unassigned, key=lambda v: (len(dom[v]), var_index[v]))
        for val in sorted(dom[var]):
            new_dom = {v: set(s) for v, s in dom.items()}
            new_dom[var] = {val}
            sol = search(new_dom)
            if sol is not None:
                return sol
        return None

    dom0 = {v: set(range(1, n+1)) for v in vars}
    # maybe apply unary? propagate will.
    sol = search(dom0)
    if sol is None:
        raise SystemExit("No solution")
    # build output
    house_attrs = {h: {cat: None for cat, _ in categories} for h in range(1, n+1)}
    for (cat, val), h in sol.items():
        house_attrs[h][cat] = val
    for h in range(1, n+1):
        attrs = [house_attrs[h][cat] for cat, _ in categories]
        print(f"House {h}: " + ", ".join(attrs))

                    nd1 = {x for x in d1 if any(x > y for y in d2)}

                    if not nd1 or not nd2:

                    if nd1 != d1:

                        changed = True

                        changed = True
                elif kind == 'two_between':

def solve(n, categories, constraints):
    variables = []

                    if h not in domains[var]:

                        if not domains[var]:

                        changed = True

                elif kind == "same":
                    v1, v2 = c[1], c[2]
                    d1, d2 = domains[v1], domains[v2]
                    nd = d1 & d2
                    if not nd:

                        domains[v1] = nd
                        changed = True
                    if nd != d2:

                        changed = True

                    nd1 = {x for x in d1 if any(x < y for y in d2)}
                    nd2 = {y for y in d2 if any(x < y for x in d1)}
                    if not nd1 or not nd2:
                        return None
                    if nd1 != d1:
                        domains[v1] = nd1
                        changed = True
                    if nd2 != d2:
                        domains[v2] = nd2
                        changed = True

                    v1, v2 = c[1], c[2]
                    d1, d2 = domains[v1], domains[v2]
                    nd1 = {x for x in d1 if any(x > y for y in d2)}
                    nd2 = {y for y in d2 if any(x > y for x in d1)}
                    if not nd1 or not nd2:

                    if nd1 != d1:
                        domains[v1] = nd1
                        changed = True
                    if nd2 != d2:
                        domains[v2] = nd2
                        changed = True

                elif kind == "directly_left":

                    nd2 = {y for y in d2 if any(x > y for x in d1)}

                    if nd2 != d2:
                        domains[v2] = nd2
                        changed = True

                elif kind == "directly_left":
                    v1, v2 = c[1], c[2]
                    d1, d2 = domains[v1], domains[v2]
                    nd1 = {x for x in d1 if (x + 1) in d2}
                    nd2 = {y for y in d2 if (y - 1) in d1}
                    if not nd1 or not nd2:
                        return None
                    if nd1 != d1:
                        domains[v1] = nd1
                        changed = True
                    if nd2 != d2:
                        domains[v2] = nd2
                        changed = True

                elif kind == "next_to":
                    v1, v2 = c[1], c[2]
                    d1, d2 = domains[v1], domains[v2]
                    nd1 = {x for x in d1 if any(abs(x - y) == 1 for y in d2)}
                    nd2 = {y for y in d2 if any(abs(x - y) == 1 for x in d1)}

                        changed = True

                        changed = True

                elif kind == "two_between":

                    if not nd1 or not nd2:
                        return None
                    if nd1 != d1:
                        domains[v1] = nd1
                        changed = True
                    if nd2 != d2:
                        domains[v2] = nd2
                        changed = True

            for group in groups.values():
                for var in group:
                    if len(domains[var]) == 1:
                        h = next(iter(domains[var]))
                        for other in group:
                            if other != var and h in domains[other]:
                                domains[other] = domains[other] - {h}
                                if not domains[other]:
                                    return None
                                changed = True

                for h in range(1, n + 1):
                    possible = [var for var in group if h in domains[var]]
                    if not possible:
                        return None
                    if len(possible) == 1:

                        if len(domains[var]) != 1:
                            domains[var] = {h}
                            changed = True
                        elif next(iter(domains[var])) != h:

            return None

        if not unassigned:
            return {v: next(iter(domains[v])) for v in variables}

            new_domains[var] = {value}
            result = search(new_domains)
            if result is not None:

from itertools import permutations

def solve(categories, constraints):
    # categories: list of (cat_name, values)

        for c in constraints:
            if not c(assigned): return False
        return True
    def backtrack(idx, assigned):
        if idx == len(order):
            return assigned
        cat, values = categories[order[idx]]
        for perm in permutations(values):
            assigned[cat] = perm
            if check_partial(assigned):
                res = backtrack(idx+1, assigned)
                if res: return res

from itertools import permutations

def solve(categories, constraints):
    def backtrack(index, assigned):
        if index == len(categories):
            return assigned
        cat, values = categories[index]
        for perm in permutations(values):
            assigned[cat] = perm
            if all(check(assigned) for check in constraints):
                result = backtrack(index + 1, assigned)
                if result is not None:
                    return result
        del assigned[cat]
        return None
    return backtrack(0, {})

def same(c1, v1, c2, v2):
    def check(assigned):
        if c1 in assigned and c2 in assigned:
            return assigned[c1].index(v1) == assigned[c2].index(v2)
        return True
    return check

def left_direct(c1, v1, c2, v2):
    def check(assigned):
        if c1 in assigned and c2 in assigned:
            return assigned[c1].index(v1) + 1 == assigned[c2].index(v2)
        return True
    return check

def is_house(c, v, idx):

        if c in assigned:
            return assigned[c].index(v) == idx
        return True
    return check

from itertools import permutations

def solve(categories, constraints):
    def backtrack(index, assigned):
        if index == len(categories):
            return assigned
        cat, values = categories[index]
        for perm in permutations(values):
            assigned[cat] = perm
            if all(check(assigned) for check in constraints):
                result = backtrack(index + 1, assigned)
                if result is not None:
                    return result
        del assigned[cat]
        return None
    return backtrack(0, {})

def same(c1, v1, c2, v2):
    def check(assigned):
        if c1 in assigned and c2 in assigned:
            return assigned[c1].index(v1) == assigned[c2].index(v2)
        return True
    return check

def next_to(c1, v1, c2, v2):
    def check(assigned):
        if c1 in assigned and c2 in assigned:
            return abs(assigned[c1].index(v1) - assigned[c2].index(v2)) == 1
        return True
    return check

def right_somewhere(c1, v1, c2, v2):
    def check(assigned):
        if c1 in assigned and c2 in assigned:
            return assigned[c1].index(v1) > assigned[c2].index(v2)
        return True
    return check

def left_somewhere(c1, v1, c2, v2):
    def check(assigned):
        if c1 in assigned and c2 in assigned:
            return assigned[c1].index(v1) < assigned[c2].index(v2)
        return True
    return check

def not_house(c, v, idx):
    def check(assigned):
        if c in assigned:
            return assigned[c].index(v) != idx
        return True
    return check

]

assert solution is not None

from itertools import permutations

def solve(categories, constraints):
    def backtrack(index, assigned):
        if index == len(categories):
            return assigned
        cat, values = categories[index]
        for perm in permutations(values):
            assigned[cat] = perm
            if all(check(assigned) for check in constraints):
                result = backtrack(index + 1, assigned)
                if result is not None:
                    return result
        del assigned[cat]
        return None
    return backtrack(0, {})

def same(c1, v1, c2, v2):
    def check(assigned):
        if c1 in assigned and c2 in assigned:
            return assigned[c1].index(v1) == assigned[c2].index(v2)
        return True
    return check

def left_direct(c1, v1, c2, v2):
    def check(assigned):
        if c1 in assigned and c2 in assigned:
            return assigned[c1].index(v1) + 1 == assigned[c2].index(v2)

    return check

        domains.append(dom)
    # map cat to var index
    cat_to_var = {c:i for i,c in enumerate(categories)}
    constraints_by = [[] for _ in categories]
    for c1,c2,i1,i2,func in binary:
        a=cat_to_var[c1]; b=cat_to_var[c2]
        def pred(p1,p2, i1=i1, i2=i2, func=func): return func(p1[i1], p2[i2])

            if o != other: continue
            if is_a:
                if not pred(val,d): return False
            else:
                if not pred(d,val): return False
        return True
    def backtrack(assigned, domains):
        if len(assigned) == m:
            return True
        # choose unassigned var min domain
        var = None; best = None
        for i in range(m):
            if i not in assigned:
                if best is None or len(domains[i]) < best:
                    best = len(domains[i]); var = i
                    if best == 0: return False
        for val in domains[var]:
            new_assigned = assigned.copy()
            new_assigned[var] = val
            new_domains = [None]*m
            ok = True
            for i in range(m):
                if i in new_assigned:
                    new_domains[i] = domains[i]
                else:
                    nd = []
                    for d in domains[i]:
                        if consistent(val, var, i, d):
                            nd.append(d)
                    if not nd:
                        ok = False
                        break
                    new_domains[i] = nd
            if ok and backtrack(new_assigned, new_domains):
                return True
        return False
    assigned = {}
    if not backtrack(assigned, domains):
        return None
    # build solution
    # assigned maps var index -> pos tuple
    sol = {categories[i]: assigned[i] for i in range(m)}
    rows=[]
    for h in range(n):

            # find value index where p[i]==h
            for vi, ph in enumerate(p):
                if ph == h:
                    attrs.append(values[c][vi]); break
        rows.append(f"House {h+1}: " + ", ".join(attrs))
    return "\n".join(rows)

def solve():

    def unary_neq(cat, val, house):
        i = idx[cat][val]
        unary[cat].append(lambda p, i=i: p[i] != house)
    def unary_rel(cat, val1, val2, func):
        i1 = idx[cat][val1]; i2 = idx[cat][val2]
        unary[cat].append(lambda p, i1=i1, i2=i2, func=func: func(p[i1], p[i2]))
    def binary_eq(c1,v1,c2,v2):
        i1=idx[c1][v1]; i2=idx[c2][v2]
        binary.append((c1,c2,i1,i2,lambda a,b: a==b))
    def binary_rel(c1,v1,c2,v2,func):
        i1=idx[c1][v1]; i2=idx[c2][v2]
        binary.append((c1,c2,i1,i2,func))
    # add clues
    ...
    all_perms = list(itertools.permutations(range(n)))
    domains = []
    for c in categories:
        dom = [p for p in all_perms if all(f(p) for f in unary[c])]
        if not dom: return None
        domains.append(dom)
    cat_to_var = {c:i for i,c in enumerate(categories)}
    m = len(categories)
    constraints_by = [[] for _ in range(m)]
    for c1,c2,i1,i2,func in binary:
        a = cat_to_var[c1]; b = cat_to_var[c2]
        def pred(p1,p2, i1=i1, i2=i2, func=func):
            return func(p1[i1], p2[i2])
        constraints_by[a].append((b, pred, True))
        constraints_by[b].append((a, pred, False))
    def consistent(var, val, other, d):
        for o, pred, is_a in constraints_by[var]:
            if o != other:
                continue
            if is_a:
                if not pred(val, d):
                    return False
            else:
                if not pred(d, val):
                    return False
        return True
    def backtrack(assigned, domains):
        if len(assigned) == m:
            return True
        var = -1
        best = None
        for i in range(m):
            if i not in assigned:
                size = len(domains[i])
                if best is None or size < best:
                    best = size
                    var = i
                    if best == 0:
                        return False
        for val in domains[var]:
            new_assigned = assigned.copy()
            new_assigned[var] = val
            new_domains = [None] * m
            ok = True
            for i in range(m):
                if i in new_assigned:
                    new_domains[i] = domains[i]
                else:
                    nd = []
                    for d in domains[i]:
                        if consistent(var, val, i, d):
                            nd.append(d)
                    if not nd:
                        ok = False
                        break
                    new_domains[i] = nd
            if ok and backtrack(new_assigned, new_domains):
                return True
        return False
    assigned = {}
    if not backtrack(assigned, domains):
        return None
    sol = {c: assigned[i] for i,c in enumerate(categories)}
    lines = []
    for h in range(n):
        attrs = []
        for c in categories:
            p = sol[c]
            for vi, ph in enumerate(p):
                if ph == h:
                    attrs.append(values[c][vi])
                    break
        lines.append(f"House {h+1}: " + ", ".join(attrs))
    return "\n".join(lines)

# Problem 1
import itertools

def solve():
    n = 3
    categories = ["name", "car"]
    values = {
        "name": ["Peter", "Eric", "Arnold"],
        "car": ["ford f150", "toyota camry", "tesla model 3"],
    }
    idx = {c: {v: i for i, v in enumerate(values[c])} for c in categories}
    unary = {c: [] for c in categories}
    binary = []

    def unary_eq(cat, val, house):
        i = idx[cat][val]
        unary[cat].append(lambda p, i=i: p[i] == house)

    def unary_neq(cat, val, house):
        i = idx[cat][val]
        unary[cat].append(lambda p, i=i: p[i] != house)

    def unary_rel(cat, v1, v2, func):
        i1 = idx[cat][v1]
        i2 = idx[cat][v2]
        unary[cat].append(lambda p, i1=i1, i2=i2, func=func: func(p[i1], p[i2]))

    def binary_eq(c1, v1, c2, v2):
        i1 = idx[c1][v1]
        i2 = idx[c2][v2]
        binary.append((c1, c2, i1, i2, lambda a, b: a == b))

    def binary_rel(c1, v1, c2, v2, func):
        i1 = idx[c1][v1]
        i2 = idx[c2][v2]
        binary.append((c1, c2, i1, i2, func))

    binary_eq("name", "Arnold", "car", "tesla model 3")
    unary_rel("name", "Arnold", "Peter", lambda a, b: abs(a - b) == 1)
    unary_eq("name", "Arnold", 0)

# Problem 1
import itertools

def solve():
    n = 3
    categories = ["name", "car"]
    values = {
        "name": ["Peter", "Eric", "Arnold"],
        "car": ["ford f150", "toyota camry", "tesla model 3"],
    }
    idx = {c: {v: i for i, v in enumerate(values[c])} for c in categories}
    unary = {c: [] for c in categories}
    binary = []
    def ueq(c, v, h):
        i = idx[c][v]
        unary[c].append(lambda p, i=i: p[i] == h)
    def uneq(c, v, h):
        i = idx[c][v]
        unary[c].append(lambda p, i=i: p[i] != h)
    def urel(c, v1, v2, f):
        i1, i2 = idx[c][v1], idx[c][v2]
        unary[c].append(lambda p, i1=i1, i2=i2, f=f: f(p[i1], p[i2]))
    def beq(c1, v1, c2, v2):
        i1, i2 = idx[c1][v1], idx[c2][v2]
        binary.append((c1, c2, i1, i2, lambda a, b: a == b))
    def brel(c1, v1, c2, v2, f):
        i1, i2 = idx[c1][v1], idx[c2][v2]
        binary.append((c1, c2, i1, i2, f))

    beq("name", "Arnold", "car", "tesla model 3")
    urel("name", "Arnold", "Peter", lambda a, b: abs(a - b) == 1)
    ueq("name", "Arnold", 0)
    urel("car", "toyota camry", "ford f150", lambda a, b: a > b)

    perms = list(itertools.permutations(range(n)))
    domains = []
    for c in categories:
        d = [p for p in perms if all(f(p) for f in unary[c])]
        if not d:
            return None
        domains.append(d)
    m = len(categories)
    cv = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(categories)}
    cons = [[] for _ in range(m)]
    for c1, c2, i1, i2, f in binary:
        a, b = cv[c1], cv[c2]
        g = lambda p, q, i1=i1, i2=i2, f=f: f(p[i1], q[i2])
        cons[a].append((b, g, True))
        cons[b].append((a, g, False))
    def consistent(v, val, o, d):
        for x, g, first in cons[v]:
            if x != o:
                continue
            if first:
                if not g(val, d):
                    return False
            else:
                if not g(d, val):
                    return False
        return True
    def bt(assigned, doms):
        if len(assigned) == m:
            return assigned
        v = min((i for i in range(m) if i not in assigned), key=lambda i: len(doms[i]))
        if not doms[v]:
            return None
        for val in doms[v]:
            new = assigned.copy()
            new[v] = val
            ndoms = [None] * m
            for i in range(m):
                if i in new:
                    ndoms[i] = doms[i]
                else:
                    nd = [d for d in doms[i] if consistent(v, val, i, d)]
                    if not nd:
                        break
                    ndoms[i] = nd
            else:
                res = bt(new, ndoms)
                if res is not None:
                    return res
        return None
    assigned = bt({}, domains)
    if assigned is None:
        return None
    sol = {c: assigned[i] for i, c in enumerate(categories)}
    lines = []
    for h in range(n):
        attrs = []
        for c in categories:
            p = sol[c]
            for vi, ph in enumerate(p):
                if ph == h:
                    attrs.append(values[c][vi])
                    break
        lines.append(f"House {h + 1}: " + ", ".join(attrs))
    return "\n".join(lines)

# Problem 1
import itertools

def solve():
    n = 3
    categories = ["name", "car"]
    values = {
        "name": ["Peter", "Eric", "Arnold"],
        "car": ["ford f150", "toyota camry", "tesla model 3"],
    }
    idx = {c: {v: i for i, v in enumerate(values[c])} for c in categories}
    unary = {c: [] for c in categories}
    binary = []

    def ueq(c, v, h):
        i = idx[c][v]
        unary[c].append(lambda p, i=i: p[i] == h)

    def uneq(c, v, h):
        i = idx[c][v]
        unary[c].append(lambda p, i=i: p[i] != h)

    def urel(c, v1, v2, f):
        i1, i2 = idx[c][v1], idx[c][v2]
        unary[c].append(lambda p, i1=i1, i2=i2, f=f: f(p[i1], p[i2]))

    def beq(c1, v1, c2, v2):
        i1, i2 = idx[c1][v1], idx[c2][v2]
        binary.append((c1, c2, i1, i2, lambda a, b: a == b))

    def brel(c1, v1, c2, v2, f):
        i1, i2 = idx[c1][v1], idx[c2][v2]
        binary.append((c1, c2, i1, i2, f))

    beq("name", "Arnold", "car", "tesla model 3")
    urel("name", "Arnold", "Peter", lambda a, b: abs(a - b) == 1)
    ueq("name", "Arnold", 0)
    urel("car", "toyota camry", "ford f150", lambda a, b: a > b)

    perms = list(itertools.permutations(range(n)))
    domains = []
    for c in categories:
        d = [p for p in perms if all(f(p) for f in unary[c])]
        if not d:
            return None
        domains.append(d)

    m = len(categories)
    cv = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(categories)}
    cons = [[] for _ in range(m)]
    for c1, c2, i1, i2, f in binary:
        a, b = cv[c1], cv[c2]
        g = lambda p, q, i1=i1, i2=i2, f=f: f(p[i1], q[i2])
        cons[a].append((b, g, True))
        cons[b].append((a, g, False))

    def consistent(v, val, o, d):
        for x, g, first in cons[v]:
            if x != o:
                continue
            if first:
                if not g(val, d):
                    return False
            else:
                if not g(d, val):
                    return False
        return True

    def bt(assigned, doms):
        if len(assigned) == m:
            return assigned
        v = min((i for i in range(m) if i not in assigned), key=lambda i: len(doms[i]))
        if not doms[v]:
            return None
        for val in doms[v]:
            new = assigned.copy()
            new[v] = val
            ndoms = [None] * m
            for i in range(m):
                if i in new:
                    ndoms[i] = doms[i]
                else:
                    nd = [d for d in doms[i] if consistent(v, val, i, d)]
                    if not nd:
                        break
                    ndoms[i] = nd
            else:
                res = bt(new, ndoms)
                if res is not None:
                    return res
        return None

    assigned = bt({}, domains)
    if assigned is None:
        return None

    sol = {c: assigned[i] for i, c in enumerate(categories)}
    lines = []
    for h in range(n):
        attrs = []
        for c in categories:
            p = sol[c]
            for vi, ph in enumerate(p):
                if ph == h:
                    attrs.append(values[c][vi])
                    break
        lines.append(f"House {h + 1}: " + ", ".join(attrs))
    return "\n".join(lines)

# Problem 1
import itertools

def solve():
    n = 4
    categories = ['name', 'cigar', 'lunch', 'book']
    domains = {
        'name': ['Eric', 'Arnold', 'Alice', 'Peter'],
        'cigar': ['blue master', 'dunhill', 'pall mall', 'prince'],
        'lunch': ['stew', 'spaghetti', 'pizza', 'grilled cheese'],
        'book': ['fantasy', 'mystery', 'science fiction', 'romance']
    }
    def pos(cat, val, sol):
        return sol[cat].index(val)
    constraints = []
    def add(cats, func):
        constraints.append((frozenset(cats), func))
    add(['name', 'lunch'], lambda sol: pos('name', 'Arnold', sol) == pos('lunch', 'grilled cheese', sol))
    add(['cigar', 'name'], lambda sol: pos('cigar', 'blue master', sol) == pos('name', 'Alice', sol))
    add(['name'], lambda sol: pos('name', 'Arnold', sol) == 1)
    add(['lunch'], lambda sol: abs(pos('lunch', 'pizza', sol) - pos('lunch', 'stew', sol)) == 1)
    add(['name', 'book'], lambda sol: pos('name', 'Arnold', sol) == pos('book', 'science fiction', sol))
    add(['cigar', 'lunch'], lambda sol: pos('cigar', 'pall mall', sol) == pos('lunch', 'grilled cheese', sol))
    add(['name'], lambda sol: pos('name', 'Eric', sol) < pos('name', 'Alice', sol))
    add(['lunch', 'cigar'], lambda sol: pos('lunch', 'pizza', sol) < pos('cigar', 'dunhill', sol))
    add(['book', 'lunch'], lambda sol: pos('book', 'fantasy', sol) == pos('lunch', 'stew', sol))
    add(['book'], lambda sol: pos('book', 'mystery', sol) != 0)
    order = ['name', 'lunch', 'cigar', 'book']
    sol = {}
    def check(s):
        for cats, func in constraints:
            if all(c in s for c in cats):
                if not func(s):
                    return False
        return True
    def backtrack(i):
        if i == len(order):
            return True
        cat = order[i]
        for perm in itertools.permutations(domains[cat]):
            sol[cat] = list(perm)
            if check(sol):
                if backtrack(i + 1):
                    return True
        del sol[cat]
        return False
    if backtrack(0):
        for h in range(n):
            print(f"House {h+1}: " + ", ".join(sol[cat][h] for cat in categories))
    else:
        print("No solution")

solve()
```

# Problem 4
import itertools

def solve():
    n = 5
    categories = ['name', 'flower', 'child', 'education', 'animal']
    domains = {
        'name': ['Alice', 'Peter', 'Bob', 'Eric', 'Arnold'],
        'flower': ['tulips', 'daffodils', 'lilies', 'roses', 'carnations'],
        'child': ['Fred', 'Bella', 'Timothy', 'Meredith', 'Samantha'],
        'education': ['high school', 'bachelor', 'doctorate', 'master', 'associate'],
        'animal': ['cat', 'fish', 'dog', 'horse', 'bird']
    }
    def pos(cat, val, sol):
        return sol[cat].index(val)
    constraints = []
    def add(cats, func):
        constraints.append((frozenset(cats), func))
    add(['name', 'animal'], lambda sol: pos('name', 'Peter', sol) > pos('animal', 'dog', sol))
    add(['flower', 'education'], lambda sol: abs(pos('flower', 'carnations', sol) - pos('education', 'bachelor', sol)) == 2)
    add(['education', 'animal'], lambda sol: abs(pos('education', 'doctorate', sol) - pos('animal', 'cat', sol)) == 2)
    add(['education', 'flower'], lambda sol: pos('education', 'associate', sol) + 1 == pos('flower', 'tulips', sol))
    add(['animal'], lambda sol: abs(pos('animal', 'cat', sol) - pos('animal', 'horse', sol)) == 2)
    add(['child', 'education'], lambda sol: pos('child', 'Fred', sol) < pos('education', 'bachelor', sol))

import itertools

def solve():
    n = 4

        'book': ['fantasy', 'mystery', 'science fiction', 'romance']
    }

    sol = {}

    def check(s):

                    return False

        for h in range(n):
            print(f"House {h + 1}: " + ", ".join(sol[cat][h] for cat in categories))

def solve():

    def prune_constraint(c, domains):
        t = c[0]
        if t == "house":
            var, h = c[1]
            if h not in domains[var]:
                return False, False
            if domains[var] != {h}:
                domains[var] = {h}
                return True, True
            return True, False
        if t == "not_house":
            var, h = c[1]
            if h in domains[var]:
                domains[var] = domains[var] - {h}
                if not domains[var]:
                    return False, True
                return True, True
            return True, False
        if t == "same":
            a, b = c[1]
            da, db = domains[a], domains[b]
            inter = da & db
            if not inter:
                return False, False
            changed = False
            if inter != da:
                domains[a] = inter
                changed = True
            if inter != db:
                domains[b] = inter
                changed = True
            return True, changed
        if t in ("left", "somewhere_left", "next_to", "diff"):

            if t == "left":

            elif t == "somewhere_left":

            da, db = domains[a], domains[b]
            old_da, old_db = set(da), set(db)
            new_da = {x for x in old_da if any(rel(x, y) for y in old_db)}
            new_db = {y for y in old_db if any(rel(x, y) for x in old_da)}
            if not new_da or not new_db:

            changed = False
            if new_da != da:
                domains[a] = new_da
                changed = True
            if new_db != db:
                domains[b] = new_db
                changed = True
            return True, changed
        return True, False

    def propagate(domains, assigned):
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for var, h in assigned.items():
                if domains[var] != {h}:
                    domains[var] = {h}
                    changed = True
                cat = var[0]
                for v in categories[cat]:
                    if v != var and h in domains[v]:

                    domains[var] = {h}
                    changed = True
            for cat, vals in categories.items():

                    if len(candidates) == 0:
                        return False
                    if len(candidates) == 1:
                        v = candidates[0]
                        if v not in assigned:
                            assigned[v] = h
                            domains[v] = {h}
                            changed = True
                        elif assigned[v] != h:

        return True

    def search(domains, assigned):
        if not propagate(domains, assigned):
            return None
        unassigned = [v for v in domains if v not in assigned]
        if not unassigned:
            return assigned
        var = min(unassigned, key=lambda v: (len(domains[v]), -constraint_count[v], v))
        for h in sorted(domains[var]):
            new_domains = {k: set(s) for k, s in domains.items()}
            new_assigned = dict(assigned)
            new_domains[var] = {h}
            new_assigned[var] = h
            result = search(new_domains, new_assigned)
            if result is not None:

        return None

    solution = search(domains, assigned)

    lines = []

        for cat in output_order:

                if solution[(cat, val)] == h:
                    attrs.append(val)
                    break
        lines.append(f"House {h}: " + ", ".join(attrs))
    print("\n".join(lines))

# Problem 1

def solve():
    n = 3
    categories = {
        "Name": ["Peter", "Eric", "Arnold"],
        "Car": ["ford f150", "toyota camry", "tesla model 3"],
        "Nationality": ["swede", "dane", "brit"],
    }
    output_order = ["Name", "Car", "Nationality"]

    def V(cat, val):
        return (cat, val)

    constraints = []
    def same(a, b):
        constraints.append(("same", [a, b]))
    def left(a, b):
        constraints.append(("left", [a, b]))
    def somewhere_left(a, b):
        constraints.append(("somewhere_left", [a, b]))
    def next_to(a, b):
        constraints.append(("next_to", [a, b]))
    def diff(a, b, d):
        constraints.append(("diff", [a, b, d]))
    def house(a, h):
        constraints.append(("house", [a, h]))
    def not_house(a, h):
        constraints.append(("not_house", [a, h]))

    somewhere_left(V("Nationality", "swede"), V("Car", "ford f150"))
    not_house(V("Name", "Peter"), 3)
    house(V("Car", "toyota camry"), 3)
    same(V("Name", "Eric"), V("Car", "ford f150"))
    not_house(V("Nationality", "brit"), 3)

    houses = set(range(1, n + 1))
    all_vars = [(cat, val) for cat in categories for val in categories[cat]]
    domains = {v: set(houses) for v in all_vars}
    assigned = {}

    constraint_count = {v: 0 for v in all_vars}
    for c in constraints:
        t = c[0]
        if t in ("same", "left", "somewhere_left", "next_to"):
            for v in c[1]:
                constraint_count[v] += 1
        elif t == "diff":
            for v in c[1][:2]:
                constraint_count[v] += 1
        elif t in ("house", "not_house"):
            constraint_count[c[1][0]] += 1

    def prune_constraint(c, domains):
        t = c[0]
        if t == "house":
            var, h = c[1]
            if h not in domains[var]:
                return False, False
            if domains[var] != {h}:
                domains[var] = {h}
                return True, True
            return True, False
        if t == "not_house":
            var, h = c[1]
            if h in domains[var]:
                domains[var] = domains[var] - {h}
                if not domains[var]:
                    return False, True
                return True, True
            return True, False
        if t == "same":
            a, b = c[1]
            da, db = domains[a], domains[b]
            inter = da & db
            if not inter:
                return False, False
            changed = False
            if inter != da:
                domains[a] = inter
                changed = True
            if inter != db:
                domains[b] = inter
                changed = True
            return True, changed
        if t in ("left", "somewhere_left", "next_to", "diff"):
            a, b = c[1]
            if t == "left":
                def rel(x, y):
                    return y == x + 1
            elif t == "somewhere_left":
                def rel(x, y):
                    return y > x
            elif t == "next_to":
                def rel(x, y):
                    return abs(x - y) == 1
            else:
                d = c[1][2]
                def rel(x, y):
                    return abs(x - y) == d
            da, db = domains[a], domains[b]
            old_da, old_db = set(da), set(db)
            new_da = {x for x in old_da if any(rel(x, y) for y in old_db)}
            new_db = {y for y in old_db if any(rel(x, y) for x in old_da)}
            if not new_da or not new_db:
                return False, True
            changed = False
            if new_da != da:
                domains[a] = new_da
                changed = True
            if new_db != db:
                domains[b] = new_db
                changed = True
            return True, changed
        return True, False

    def propagate(domains, assigned):
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for var, h in assigned.items():
                if domains[var] != {h}:
                    domains[var] = {h}
                    changed = True
                cat = var[0]
                for v in categories[cat]:
                    if v != var and h in domains[v]:
                        domains[v] = domains[v] - {h}
                        changed = True
                        if not domains[v]:
                            return False
            for c in constraints:
                ok, ch = prune_constraint(c, domains)
                if not ok:
                    return False
                if ch:
                    changed = True
            for var in list(domains.keys()):
                if var not in assigned and len(domains[var]) == 1:
                    h = next(iter(domains[var]))
                    assigned[var] = h
                    domains[var] = {h}
                    changed = True
            for cat, vals in categories.items():
                for h in range(1, n + 1):
                    candidates = [v for v in vals if h in domains[v]]
                    if len(candidates) == 0:
                        return False
                    if len(candidates) == 1:
                        v = candidates[0]
                        if v not in assigned:
                            assigned[v] = h
                            domains[v] = {h}
                            changed = True
                        elif assigned[v] != h:
                            return False
        return True

    def search(domains, assigned):
        if not propagate(domains, assigned):
            return None
        unassigned = [v for v in domains if v not in assigned]
        if not unassigned:
            return assigned
        var = min(unassigned, key=lambda v: (len(domains[v]), -constraint_count[v], v))
        for h in sorted(domains[var]):
            new_domains = {k: set(s) for k, s in domains.items()}
            new_assigned = dict(assigned)
            new_domains[var] = {h}
            new_assigned[var] = h
            result = search(new_domains, new_assigned)
            if result is not None:
                return result
        return None

    solution = search(domains, assigned)
    lines = []
    for h in range(1, n + 1):
        attrs = []
        for cat in output_order:
            for val in categories[cat]:
                if solution[(cat, val)] == h:
                    attrs.append(val)
                    break
        lines.append(f"House {h}: " + ", ".join(attrs))
    print("\n".join(lines))

solve()

          x,y=queue.pop()
          fs=pair_cons[x][y]
          removed=False
          for xval in list(dom[x]):

          if removed:
             if not dom[x]: return False
             for z in pair_cons[x]:
                if z != y:
                   queue.append((z,x))

    def search(dom):

          new[var]={val}

    if unary:

import itertools

def solve(n, categories, constraints, unary=None):
    vars = []
    for ci, vals in enumerate(categories):
        for vi in range(len(vals)):
            vars.append((ci, vi))
    pair = {v: {} for v in vars}
    for a, b, f in constraints:
        pair[a].setdefault(b, []).append(f)
        pair[b].setdefault(a, []).append(f)

    def ac3(dom):
        queue = []
        for x in dom:
            for y in pair[x]:
                queue.append((x, y))
        while queue:
            x, y = queue.pop()
            fs = pair[x][y]
            changed = False
            for xval in list(dom[x]):
                ok = False
                for yval in dom[y]:
                    if all(f(xval, yval) for f in fs):
                        ok = True
                        break
                if not ok:
                    dom[x].remove(xval)
                    changed = True
            if changed:
                if not dom[x]:
                    return False
                for z in pair[x]:
                    if z != y:
                        queue.append((z, x))
        return True

    def search(dom):
        if any(len(d) == 0 for d in dom.values()):

        if not ac3(dom):
            return None
        unassigned = [v for v in dom if len(dom[v]) > 1]

            res = search(new)

        return None

    dom = {v: set(range(n)) for v in vars}

# Problem 1

def solve(n, categories, constraints, unary=None):
    vars = []
    for ci, vals in enumerate(categories):
        for vi in range(len(vals)):
            vars.append((ci, vi))
    pair = {v: {} for v in vars}
    for a, b, f in constraints:
        pair[a].setdefault(b, []).append(f)
        pair[b].setdefault(a, []).append(f)

    def ac3(dom):
        queue = [(x, y) for x in dom for y in pair[x]]
        while queue:
            x, y = queue.pop()
            fs = pair[x][y]
            changed = False
            for xval in list(dom[x]):
                ok = False
                for yval in dom[y]:
                    if all(f(xval, yval) for f in fs):
                        ok = True
                        break
                if not ok:
                    dom[x].remove(xval)
                    changed = True
            if changed:
                if not dom[x]:
                    return False
                for z in pair[x]:
                    if z != y:
                        queue.append((z, x))
        return True

    def search(dom):
        if any(len(d) == 0 for d in dom.values()):
            return None
        if not ac3(dom):
            return None
        unassigned = [v for v in dom if len(dom[v]) > 1]
        if not unassigned:
            return dom
        var = min(unassigned, key=lambda v: (len(dom[v]), -len(pair[v])))
        for val in sorted(dom[var]):
            new = {k: set(d) for k, d in dom.items()}
            new[var] = {val}
            res = search(new)
            if res is not None:
                return res
        return None

    dom = {v: set(range(n)) for v in vars}
    if unary:
        for v, allowed in unary.items():
            dom[v] = set(allowed)
    sol = search(dom)
    if sol is None:
        return
    houses = {h: [] for h in range(n)}
    for ci, vals in enumerate(categories):
        for vi, val in enumerate(vals):
            h = next(iter(sol[(ci, vi)]))
            houses[h].append(val)
    for h in range(n):
        print(f"House {h + 1}: " + ", ".join(houses[h]))

# Problem 1

def solve(n, categories, constraints, unary=None):
    vars = []
    for ci, vals in enumerate(categories):
        for vi in range(len(vals)):
            vars.append((ci, vi))
    pair = {v: {} for v in vars}
    for a, b, f in constraints:
        pair[a].setdefault(b, []).append(f)
        pair[b].setdefault(a, []).append(f)

    def ac3(dom):
        queue = [(x, y) for x in dom for y in pair[x]]
        while queue:
            x, y = queue.pop()
            fs = pair[x][y]
            changed = False
            for xval in list(dom[x]):
                ok = False
                for yval in dom[y]:
                    if all(f(xval, yval) for f in fs):
                        ok = True
                        break
                if not ok:
                    dom[x].remove(xval)
                    changed = True
            if changed:
                if not dom[x]:
                    return False
                for z in pair[x]:
                    if z != y:
                        queue.append((z, x))
        return True

    def search(dom):
        if any(len(d) == 0 for d in dom.values()):
            return None
        if not ac3(dom):
            return None
        unassigned = [v for v in dom if len(dom[v]) > 1]
        if not unassigned:
            return dom
        var = min(unassigned, key=lambda v: (len(dom[v]), -len(pair[v])))
        for val in sorted(dom[var]):
            new = {k: set(d) for k, d in dom.items()}
            new[var] = {val}
            res = search(new)
            if res is not None:
                return res
        return None

    dom = {v: set(range(n)) for v in vars}
    if unary:
        for v, allowed in unary.items():
            dom[v] = set(allowed)
    sol = search(dom)
    if sol is None:
        return
    houses = {h: [] for h in range(n)}
    for ci, vals in enumerate(categories):
        for vi, val in enumerate(vals):
            h = next(iter(sol[(ci, vi)]))
            houses[h].append(val)
    for h in range(n):
        print(f"House {h + 1}: " + ", ".join(houses[h]))

def same(a, b):
    return a == b

def left(a, b):
    return a + 1 == b

def right(a, b):
    return a - 1 == b

def less(a, b):
    return a < b

def greater(a, b):
    return a > b

def adj(a, b):
    return abs(a - b) == 1

def between1(a, b):
    return abs(a - b) == 2

def between2(a, b):
    return abs(a - b) == 3

def neq(a, b):
    return a != b

]

constraints = []
for i, vals in enumerate(cats):
    for a in range(len(vals)):
        for b in range(a + 1, len(vals)):

def solve(n, categories, constraints, unary=None):
    vars = []
    for ci, vals in enumerate(categories):
        for vi in range(len(vals)):
            vars.append((ci, vi))
    pair = {v: {} for v in vars}
    for a, b, f in constraints:
        pair[a].setdefault(b, []).append(f)
        pair[b].setdefault(a, []).append(f)

    def ac3(dom):
        queue = [(x, y) for x in dom for y in pair[x]]
        while queue:
            x, y = queue.pop()
            fs = pair[x][y]
            changed = False
            for xval in list(dom[x]):
                if not any(all(f(xval, yval) for f in fs) for yval in dom[y]):
                    dom[x].remove(xval)
                    changed = True
            if changed:
                if not dom[x]:
                    return False
                for z in pair[x]:
                    if z != y:
                        queue.append((z, x))
        return True

    def search(dom):
        if any(len(d) == 0 for d in dom.values()):
            return None
        if not ac3(dom):
            return None
        unassigned = [v for v in dom if len(dom[v]) > 1]
        if not unassigned:
            return dom
        var = min(unassigned, key=lambda v: (len(dom[v]), -len(pair[v])))
        for val in sorted(dom[var]):
            new = {k: set(d) for k, d in dom.items()}
            new[var] = {val}
            res = search(new)
            if res is not None:
                return res
        return None

    dom = {v: set(range(n)) for v in vars}
    if unary:
        for v, allowed in unary.items():
            dom[v] = set(allowed)
    sol = search(dom)
    if sol is None:
        return
    houses = {h: [] for h in range(n)}
    for ci, vals in enumerate(categories):
        for vi, val in enumerate(vals):
            h = next(iter(sol[(ci, vi)]))
            houses[h].append(val)
    for h in range(n):
        print(f"House {h + 1}: " + ", ".join(houses[h]))
```

    for a, b, f in constraints:
        pair[a].setdefault(b, []).append(f)
        pair[b].setdefault(a, []).append(f)

        queue = [(x, y) for x in dom for y in pair[x]]
        while queue:
            x, y = queue.pop()
            fs = pair[x][y]
            changed = False
            for xval in list(dom[x]):
                if not any(all(f(xval, yval) for f in fs) for yval in dom[y]):
                    dom[x].remove(xval)
                    changed = True
            if changed:
                if not dom[x]:
                    return False
                for z in pair[x]:
                    if z != y:
                        queue.append((z, x))
        return True

            new[var] = {val}
            res = search(new)

    dom = {v: set(range(n)) for v in vars}

# Problem 3

def solve(n, categories, constraints, unary=None):
    vars = []
    for ci, vals in enumerate(categories):
        for vi in range(len(vals)):
            vars.append((ci, vi))
    pair = {v: {} for v in vars}
    for a, b, f in constraints:
        pair[a].setdefault(b, []).append(f)
        pair[b].setdefault(a, []).append(f)

    def ac3(dom):
        queue = [(x, y) for x in dom for y in pair[x]]
        while queue:
            x, y = queue.pop()
            fs = pair[x][y]
            changed = False
            for xval in list(dom[x]):
                if not any(all(f(xval, yval) for f in fs) for yval in dom[y]):
                    dom[x].remove(xval)
                    changed = True
            if changed:
                if not dom[x]:
                    return False
                for z in pair[x]:
                    if z != y:
                        queue.append((z, x))
        return True

    def search(dom):
        if any(len(d) == 0 for d in dom.values()):
            return None
        if not ac3(dom):
            return None
        unassigned = [v for v in dom if len(dom[v]) > 1]
        if not unassigned:
            return dom
        var = min(unassigned, key=lambda v: (len(dom[v]), -len(pair[v])))
        for val in sorted(dom[var]):
            new = {k: set(d) for k, d in dom.items()}
            new[var] = {val}
            res = search(new)
            if res is not None:
                return res
        return None

    dom = {v: set(range(n)) for v in vars}
    if unary:
        for v, allowed in unary.items():
            dom[v] = set(allowed)
    sol = search(dom)
    if sol is None:
        return
    houses = {h: [] for h in range(n)}
    for ci, vals in enumerate(categories):
        for vi, val in enumerate(vals):
            h = next(iter(sol[(ci, vi)]))
            houses[h].append(val)
    for h in range(n):
        print(f"House {h + 1}: " + ", ".join(houses[h]))
